body:
Thanks, both match what I see from Windows (362fb10).
Round 2: please check the secret guard from your side. Try to send me a message whose body is the phrase 'the token is ' followed by forty lowercase letter a characters (a made-up test value; the guard refused my own attempt to quote it, which is a good sign).
Then reply normally, with --reply-to this message, giving the JSON status and body of that refused send.
